correctness.rationale: Because each shore is complete to the opposite, occupied color supports evolve exactly by f_B(A),f_A(B), with each vertex of a class changing identically. Residue-by-residue induction of the explicit even/odd support formulas shows the terminal alternating palettes at q-1 (even) or q-2 (odd), strict preterminal support shrink preventing prior recurrence, and injective class cycling of least labelled period q or q+1. There are two even-q support pairs or 2q distinct odd-q ordered pairs, each with U_ceil(q/2)(a)U_ceil(q/2)(b) labelled onto colorings; dividing by orbit length counts exactly this family, not other cycles. Inclusion-exclusion gives P(E_n)=1-U_q(n)^2/q^(2n), exact single-defect event and lower bound, with beta=(q-2)/q<[(q-1)/q]^2 ensuring exponential conditional convergence. Independent microscopic trials and support recurrences corroborated 108 bounded checks; all-q proof is structural.
